Google Analytics does <strong>not</stron: Google Analytics does not give us your name, email address or anything that identifies you personally, and we don't try to find out who you are. Google Analytics uses cookies to tell one visit from the next. We have turned off Google's advertising features, and we never sell or share this information.
The Journey remembers, on your own devic: The Journey remembers, on your own device only, the nights you've found Pip and the things you've picked up, so your tally is still there when you come back. This stays in your browser and is never sent to us. Clearing your browser's site data removes it.
Tickets are handled by <strong>Zeffy</st: Tickets are handled by Zeffy, and volunteer sign-up by Church Center. When you use them, the information you give goes to them under their own privacy policies.
The Journey is made for children to enjo: The Journey is made for children to enjoy with their families. It asks for no sign-up and no personal details, and nothing a child does on it identifies them.
